original_ai_prompt: We're linking our main office and a remote site. Run OSPF between them so routes appear automatically as we add subnets. Both sites should be able to reach the internet and each other.
cleaned_prompt: We're linking our main office and a remote site. Run OSPF between them so routes appear automatically as we add subnets. Both sites should be able to reach the internet and each other.

requirements.statement: Main office and remote site reach each other
OSPF is used between the sites

expected_behaviour: Two sites, OSPF, one WAN internet block + NAT built at the main site (the engine builds the internet only at sites[0], CG-3); the remote site reaches the internet through it. A second, independent line at the remote site is a capability gap, not something the engine delivers.
capability_limitations: Two sites, OSPF, one WAN internet block + NAT built at the main site (the engine builds the internet only at sites[0], CG-3); the remote site reaches the internet through it. A second, independent line at the remote site is a capability gap, not something the engine delivers.
why_suitable: OSPF across two sites with internet at both — a shape the coverage matrix certifies; keeps routing coverage from being static-only.
